name: Elune's Grace
label: Quest
description: From Dolanaar, night elf priests return to Darnassus for Elune's Grace. The rite marks their readiness to wield divine talents unique to their people.

clips.title: The story
paras: From Dolanaar, night elf priests return to Darnassus for Elune's Grace. The rite marks their readiness to wield divine talents unique to their people.

A priest's path in the Sisterhood of Elune calls for more than skill in prayers of mending and smiting. As acolytes gain experience, they reach a threshold where they may receive blessings granted only to the kaldorei. Local mentors such as Laurna Morninglight in Dolanaar cannot bestow these deeper arts, so they send promising disciples to the spiritual heart of their order.

Initiates cross Teldrassil to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. Beneath the gaze of the high priesthood, Priestess Alathea judges whether each petitioner is ready to bear the goddess's defensive mantle. Elune's Grace is taught there as a divine talent reserved for the kaldorei.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A wonderful day has come, friend. You've reached the age in which our priests are trained in abilities only Night elves know. But it is not for me to train you. You must return to the Temple of the Moon and speak to Priestess Alathea as soon as your business here is concluded. She will test you to ensure you're prepared, and only then will she teach you Elune's Grace.

clips.title: Completion
paras: By devoting yourself to Elune and our people, you have attained a state that not all of us can achieve. It is tradition that you then be taught even greater abilities for your devotion. Do you accept?
